lineage.description: Village-level flood impact data collected through direct observation by BNPB during the January 2020 flood event in Bogor and Lebak districts, West Java. Administrative boundaries from BPS-Statistics Indonesia (2016) were used to spatially delineate affected villages. The dataset represents post-event impact records at the village administrative unit level.
